issue.title: api.commandMode prefill opener so the Reference editor's File name row opens a prefilled bob ref rename

task_type_fields.proposal:
Proposed by bob-cli-qp.6 (note #1, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP) and triaged by the bob-cli-qp land agent.

Add an api.commandMode entry that opens the Bob Command Mode sheet with editable, unresolved text and a caret position, for example `openPrefill(text, {caret})`. Then route the Reference editor's owned File name row (bob-ledger-tools 249v-plugin-ref-note-card-editor-routing.js) through it, so Enter opens the sheet prefilled with `bob ref rename <stem> ` and the cursor where the new name goes.

Today api.commandMode v1 (bob-command-mode main.js) offers only `runText` and `openText`, and both resolve a complete command first: `openText` goes through cmApiResolveForActivation into confirm, review, or output. A rename template with a `<NEW>` placeholder cannot use either. So 249v runs `executeCommandById("bob-command-mode:open")` to open an empty sheet and copies `bob ref rename <stem> <NEW>` to the clipboard for the user to paste (249v:122, :153, :179). The prefill entry needs a version bump and a capability probe, so ledger-tools keeps today's copy fallback on an older Command Mode.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The Ref Cards epic owns the Reference editor, not Bob Command Mode's public API. Adding a new cross-plugin api.commandMode entry point is a separate contract change, so qp.6 shipped the documented copy-and-open fallback instead.

issue.creation_reason: The Reference editor (bob-cli-qp.6) can only copy the rename command and open an empty Command Mode sheet, because api.commandMode has no way to open editable unresolved text.
